changes.reason: Two official Rent Board sources disagree on the construction cutoff: D009 says new construction means a Certificate of Occupancy 'after June 1980', while D006 says a certificate of occupancy 'issued after 1980'.

changes.after_json: "Construction cutoff conflict between official Rent Board sources: the coverage guide (D009) treats units built and receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 as partially covered (no rent control), implying a cutoff of 1980-06-30. The Measure BB page (D006) defines new construction as units with a certificate of occupancy issued after 1980, implying 1980-12-31. The record follows D009; units with a Certificate of Occupancy dated July-December 1980 should be verified against BMC ch. 13.76."
changes.reason: The note records the conflicting cutoff dates in D009 and D006 so the flagged conflict is explained.
